acceptanceCriteria: A focused test shows an index-file change resolves to a specific reference instead of unresolved-reference.
body:
Source: w6 appmap-impact lane report (2026-10-11), branch claude/w6-appmap-impact 31fb799d8.

Observed: changes to index files mostly come out `unresolved-reference` because the token `index` is too common.

Expected: index-file changes resolve with better precision than a bare `index` token match.

title: Improve precision for index-file changes that resolve to unresolved-reference
